group_position: first shot of grp018 — Alice on her map start (glass_table, at the table edge facing the curtain); the map gives her no path, so her feet do not move for the whole group.

characters.label: Alice
characters.start_pos: at the edge of the glass table, the bottle coming up to her mouth and away again
characters.space_fragment_en: standing at the glass table, centred in frame, facing screen-left over the little bottle as she sips
characters.facing: slightly screen-left between mouthfuls — the direction of an inward inventory, not of anything in the room

beats.action: a cautious sip; surprise, then pleasure — something sweet
second sip; something savoury and wrong stops her dead
third sip; she laughs at herself

beats.sync: very soon she has finished it off

performance_beat.objective: identify the taste — and, having started, finish the bottle
performance_beat.emotional_arc: from careful suspicion, through three distinct discoveries, to cheerful greed

trigger.beat: the second mouthful turns savoury and stops her dead

performance_beat.end_state: bottle empty and coming down from her mouth, lips pressed together, eyes off to screen-left
